get.summary:
GetBlock returns the current block information.
Provides block height, time, chain ID, hashes, and proposer for scripts.

DecodeBytes decodes protobuf bytes to JSON string for message inspection.
Useful for converting binary protobuf messages to human-readable JSON
format.

parameters.name: type_url
parameters.description:
Type URL of the message type to decode (e.g.,
"/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend").

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: Protobuf-encoded bytes of the message to decode to JSON.

get.summary:
EncodeJson encodes a JSON string to protobuf bytes for message
construction. Useful for converting human-readable JSON to binary protobuf
format.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: JSON string representing a Cosmos SDK message to encode to protobuf bytes.

post.summary:
FunctionSchema returns JSON schemas for all public functions in a script.
Extracts function signatures, parameter types, and return types for tooling
and documentation.

get.summary:
Params queries the parameters of the script module.
Returns current configuration parameters for script execution and limits.

post.summary:
Run executes a script function in read-only mode without modifying state.
Uses cached context to ensure execution has no persistent effects.

get.summary:
ScriptInfo queries script information by address or nameservice name.
Supports both direct bech32 addresses and nameservice resolution.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description:
Script address or nameservice name to query; supports both bech32 addresses
and names.

get.summary:
VerifyTx verifies the signatures of an arbitrary transaction for
MsgArbitraryData. Implements ADR-036 arbitrary signature verification with
empty chain ID and sequence.

parameters.name: tx_json
parameters.description:
JSON representation of the transaction to verify (must contain
MsgArbitraryData).

post.summary:
Web queries the WSGI web application function of a script.
This is used in the REST API and not intended for direct use.
Executes script's WSGI application in read-only mode for web requests.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.Params.description:
Params defines the parameters for the script module.
Historical query-related fields have been removed; this message is currently
empty.

json.description: JSON representation of the decoded protobuf message.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryDecodeBytes.description: QueryDecodeBytesResponse contains the decoded JSON string.

bytes.description: Protobuf-encoded bytes of the input JSON message.

executor_address.description:
Account address used to evaluate the script; must be a valid bech32
address.

script_address.description: Script bech32 address to inspect; mutually exclusive with script_name.

script_name.description: Optional nameservice name of the script to inspect (e.g., "example.dys").

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryFunctionSch.description:
QueryFunctionSchemaRequest requests function schemas for a script.

Either script_address or script_name must be provided. The script will be
introspected to extract schemas for all public functions.

QueryFunctionSchemaResponse contains function schemas extracted from a
script.

block_hash.description: Hash of the current block (app hash from header).

app_hash.description: Application hash of the current block.

proposer_address.description: Bech32 address of the block proposer.

params.description:
Current script module parameters including execution limits and
configuration.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryParamsRespo.description: QueryParamsResponse contains the current script module parameters.

script.description: Complete script information including code, version, and metadata.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryScriptInfoR.description: QueryScriptInfoResponse contains the complete script information.

signer.description: Bech32 address of the verified signer of the MsgArbitraryData transaction.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryVerifyTxRes.description: QueryVerifyTxResponse contains the verified signer address.

result.description: Execution result returned by the script function.

attached_message_results.description: Results of the attached messages executed before the script.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.ResponseRunScrip.description: ResponseRunScript contains script execution results from read-only run.

executor_address.description: Account address used to execute the script; must be a valid bech32 address.

script_address.description: Script bech32 address to execute; mutually exclusive with script_name.

script_name.description: Optional nameservice name of the script to execute (e.g., "example.dys").

extra_code.description:
Optional extra code temporarily appended to the script for this execution.
Only allowed if the executor is the script owner.

function_name.description: Name of the function to call within the script.

args.description: Positional arguments (*args) encoded as a JSON array.

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments (**kwargs) encoded as a JSON object.

attached_messages.description:
Messages executed before the script; results available but state changes
discarded.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.RunScript.description:
RunScript requests execution of a script function in read-only mode.

Similar to MsgExec but executed in a cached context with no persistent state
changes. All execution results are returned but any state modifications are
discarded.

update_height.title: Block height at which this script was last updated

script_address.description: Bech32 account address of the script to execute.

script_name.description: Nameservice name of the script to execute (e.g., "example.dys").

httprequest.description: HTTP request string to pass to the script's WSGI application.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.WebRequest.description:
WebRequest requests execution of a script's WSGI web application.

Either script_address or script_name must be provided. The script's WSGI
application will be executed in read-only mode with no state modifications
allowed.

httpresponse.description: HTTP response string returned by the script's WSGI application.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.WebResponse.description: WebResponse contains the HTTP response from the script's WSGI application.

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.
